verdict.rationale: Claude's Research feature is documented to perform agentic multi-step web searches and deliver answers with 'easy-to-check citations' (claude-docs-20, 27, 39, 68), directly matching the story. However, independent community feedback suggests mixed real-world quality—commenters say Claude's general research 'is fine' but that ChatGPT and Gemini 'run circles around it' in depth and presentation (claude-comm-8, claude-comm-9), tempering confidence in how well-grounded/comprehensive the citations truly are. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of citation accuracy/source quality, and confirmation research draws from live/current web data versus stale index.
